content.title: Here's When the Winner of The Voice: Battle of Champions Will Be Revealed
content.text: Dreams will come true and lives will change tonight on the Season 29 Finale of The Voice. Dubbed The Voice: Battle of Champions, it's been a season of elite competition, incredible performances, and all at a breakneck pace. Three veteran Coaches, no Playoffs, and an in-studio audience voting system that means the Artists don't have to wait overnight to find out the results. Tonight, it all comes down to the Top 4 Artists, one of whom will win it all.How to WatchRepresenting Coaches Kelly Clarkson, John Legend and Adam Levine, each of the Finalists brings a unique talent to the table and has an inspiring story to match. On Team Legend, 21-year-old Lucas West is a musician's musician, a piano player and songwriter who until a few months ago worked at his family's brewery. Now, he's the last man standing as the ladies take the lead.Alexia Jayy, 31, of Team Adam is powerhouse performer who's doing it all for her kids, one of whom helped her pick her Coach when he revealed that Maroon 5 is his favorite band during the Blind Auditions. Then there are the teen queens of Team Kelly: Liv Ciara and Mikenley Brown, who came out of one of the "best Battle rounds" in Voice history as BFFs and are now headed to the Finals together. Clarkson won the special advantage of bringing an extra Artist to the Finale after winning the All-Star Showdown earlier this season. RELATED: Stream New Episodes of The Voice: Battle of Champions the Next Day on PeacockSo when exactly will the next winner of The Voice be revealed? Read on for all the details you need to know. Even though The Voice Finale isn't live this season, Host Carson Daly will, as usual, announce the winner at the end of the episode, which is two hours long and begins tonight at 9/8c on NBC. And, as always, you can catch up on episodes the day after they air on Peacock.Obviously, you should tune in to the whole episode to see the incredible performances, which will decide the outcome thanks to the real-time voting system, as well as special guests like NBA legend Jimmy Butler, who is bringing his competitive edge to The Voice for one night only.RELATED: The Voice Season 29: The Ultimate Episode-by-Episode Guide for Super FansThe Voice Artists and Coaches rehearse for "a lot longer" than you see on TVHours and hours of preparation have led to these Top 4 Artists landing a spot in The Voice Season 29 Finale. While audiences get a peek at this hard work, Clarkson revealed we only see a snippet of what actually happens during The Voice rehearsals with the Coaches and Artists. "It's a lot longer than the...segment you get on TV. There’s a lot of, you know, changing it up or trying different things or maybe coming back — that’s a lot of it. And that’s the fun part," Clarkson told NBC Insider, adding that she often gets to see a "whole different side" of her team members during these sessions. "It’s so fun and why the show is so successful still."RELATED: How CeeLo Green Literally Had Tricks Up His Sleeve on The Voice: "He's a Wild Man"Set your reminders and cancel your plans: The Voice: Battle of Champions Finale airs tonight, Tuesday, April 14, at 9/8c on NBC, streaming the next day on Peacock.
